AWS

Continuous 
Integration and 
Deployment 
Service 
For the deployment of the application, 
AWS CodePipeline will be utilized to 
orchestrate the provisioning of the cloud 
infrastructure, defined within the CDK 
(AWS, n.d.). A possible alternative option 
to CodePipeline was Azure DevOps 
(ADO), however, there are only a few 
benefits of using ADO at a small scale, 
since the developer would need to create 
the deployment pipelines manually, which 
may be very time consuming. 
CodePipeline offers seamless integration 
with other AWS services such as Cloud 
Formation, with very little to no code 
required to set up, making it a highly 
elusive option given the projects time 
constraints (AWS, n.d.). 
GitHub Source Control 
Management Site 
GitHub was selected for source code 
management over AWS CodeCommit, 
despite CodeCommit’s clear benefits 
regarding seamless integration with 
CodePipeline. This decision was driven by 
the authors intent display their work 
publicly in the future to potential 
employers.
